children: Shares of Atlas Energy Solutions climbed after the company said it inked two contracts with what it called a leading frontier artificial-intelligence lab.
The stock rose 6.9% to $11.75 in premarket trading Friday. Through Thursday's close, shares are up 13% year to date.
Atlas said before the bell that the two cost-reimbursement agreements will help the undisclosed AI company to secure equipment and near-term financing.
No financial details for the deals were given.

"As the need for power infrastructure continues to grow rapidly, de-risking the supply chain and the project timelines is of paramount importance to Atlas as we work with our customers to achieve their goals of ramping [up] compute capacity," Chief Executive John Turner said.
